Hello,

I saw your opening for a Graphic Designer at Triad Marketing and wanted to reach out directly, as I am based right here in Nagpur and have been following your digital campaigns for local businesses.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives while building reusable visual systems that cut turnaround times for corporate communications. I also designed a social campaign for a fashion brand that drove a 15 percent increase in follower engagement, focusing on clear typography, layout, and consistent brand identity.

You can see that work and my broader portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a quick look at my fashion campaign case study this week?

Ananya

Hello,

I saw the UI/UX Designer opening at FetchJobs.co and was specifically drawn to your focus on transforming complex data into intuitive digital experiences.

With a Computer Science degree and hands-on UI/UX experience at AT Creation, I regularly collaborate with engineering teams to ensure accurate design implementation. During my time there, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows and interface usability. At Ascent Business Solutions, I also built reusable design systems and templates that reduced turnaround time across more than one hundred digital and print creatives.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates structured UX thinking, wireframing, and problem-solving for a B2B product (https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/).
